description: Powerful 1700W Performance – Enjoy fast, efficient, and even cooking with a high-performance 1700-watt motor that delivers powerful heat circulation. Easily set your preferred cooking time and temperature, switch between pre-sets, or monitor progress with just a few taps—no complicated buttons or guesswork required.
